name: sales
description: Sales productivity plugin for Roots.Tech — Thai Odoo ERP implementation firm. Prospect, prep for calls, analyze requirements, manage pipeline, and prepare government bids. Based on Anthropic's official sales plugin, extended with Odoo-specific skills, Thai market context, and Google Workspace connectors. Includes TOR Response Factory (9 skills + 2 agents + 10 registers) for government bid compliance, scoring matrix optimization, and G0–G6 gate-enforced pipeline. v3.1.0 adds live Odoo CE CRM/Sales integration via odoorpc-cli; v3.2.0 adds a 3-mode live sales dashboard; v3.3.0 adds the odoo-editions knowledge reference; v3.4.0 adds the Roots & BEECY brand CI reference; v3.5.0 adds the deck-builder skill that generates on-brand presentations (Interactive HTML or pptx for Google Slides). v4.0.0 adds the Hunting Strategy layer: the deal-strategy skill (scorecard v2 tier + MEDDICC + killing-zone gate + call-to-action written to Odoo chatter), a root-cause Lost/Won reason taxonomy with Odoo automation-rule hooks, and the strategy-orchestrator agent that polls flagged deals and writes next-best-actions back. v4.1.0 adds the Odoo 20 CE knowledge base (code-verified study of Odoo 20.0 Community Edition vs 19.0: module catalogue, 10 area reports, l10n_th), the odoo20-ce-expert skill, and an internal Odoo 20 Field Guide site source. v4.1.1 wires the official app-level CE-vs-EE edition matrix (odoo.com/page/editions, tagged [web]) into odoo20-ce-expert and odoo-gap-analysis so the plugin can tell which apps are Enterprise-only, kept separate from the code-verified CE facts. v4.1.2 adds Odoo subscription pricing & user-type reference (th_TH): Standard/Custom plans plus the new Light User, wired into odoo-editions and odoo20-ce-expert (tagged [web]). v4.1.3 wires the CE-vs-EE matrix and the Odoo pricing/user-type reference into sales-help routing.
